groups.name: ANY.RUN Detonate File on Windows
groups.description:
This workflow automates analysis of file on Windows using ANY.RUN's Cloud Sandbox, delivering fast, detailed threat insights. 

As a result, your SOC: 

Speeds up response: Automated interactive analysis and verdicts with 90% of threats identified in under 60 seconds. 

Improves detection accuracy: Confident decisions driven by deep threat visibility and actionable, intuitive reports with IOCs and TTPs. 

Reduces case load: Tier 1 analysts make accurate independent decisions without escalating unnecessarily. 

The playbook populates the description and other fields of the indicator with actionable intelligence: verdicts, extracted IOCs, TTPs, plus complete HTML reports.  

To use this workflow, you need an ANY.RUN subscription with API access. 

Analysis parameters can be configured in the 'Detonate File' step.

For a complete list of possible values or to configure other analysis parameters, refer to the connector documentation or the ANY.RUN API documentation at https://any.run/api-documentation.

groups.name: ANY.RUN Detonate File on Android
groups.description:
This workflow automates analysis of file on Android using ANY.RUN's Cloud Sandbox, delivering fast, detailed threat insights. 

As a result, your SOC: 

Speeds up response: Automated interactive analysis and verdicts with 90% of threats identified in under 60 seconds. 

Improves detection accuracy: Confident decisions driven by deep threat visibility and actionable, intuitive reports with IOCs and TTPs. 

Reduces case load: Tier 1 analysts make accurate independent decisions without escalating unnecessarily. 

The playbook populates the description and other fields of the indicator with actionable intelligence: verdicts, extracted IOCs, TTPs, plus complete HTML reports.  

To use this workflow, you need an ANY.RUN subscription with API access. 

Analysis parameters can be configured in the 'Detonate File' step.

For a complete list of possible values or to configure other analysis parameters, refer to the connector documentation or the ANY.RUN API documentation at https://any.run/api-documentation.
